localChanges: If the game goes quiet more than once during a long turn, or the same error repeats, you now get one message for it rather than a stack of identical windows (closes #859).
If your browser is blocking this site from storing data, the Import Assets window now says so before you choose any files, as nothing imported could be kept (#850).

If the game's engine can't be loaded, whatever was waiting on it now fails with a message instead of hanging, and an engine that never starts is reported after two minutes (closes #871, closes #872, closes #875).

log: A city's note of what its build queue dropped is cleared once you choose something else for the city, rather than lingering until its next item completes (civ-clone/web-renderer#875).
If the game's engine never starts, the page now says it has stopped answering, after two minutes, instead of waiting in silence (civ-clone/web-renderer#871).
test: the worker going quiet is said on the error channel, with the timers given
If the game's engine can't be loaded at all, whatever was waiting on it now fails straight away with a message instead of hanging (civ-clone/web-renderer#871).
